title: Rai Mai Cike Da Azaba Na Kogin Nilu
intro: A zamanin zalunci mai girma, lokacin da azzalumi ya mulki ƙasar da zalunci mai tsanani, rai ɗaya ya zaɓi hanyar imani fiye da jin daɗin sarauta. Wannan mutum ya zauna a cikin zuciyar iko amma ya sami gaskiya a cikin saƙon annabi mai tawali'u. Tafiyarsu za ta zama darasi mai ɗorewa game da haƙuri, sadaukarwa, da kuma tabbacin da ba ya misaltuwa. Za ku iya gano wannan mutum mai ban mamaki wanda ya fi son jin daɗin Allah fiye da matsayin duniya?
clues: Na zauna a cikin fadar mai iko mai girma, duk da haka zuciyata ta sami gaskiya a cikin saƙo mai tawali'u.
Na zaɓi bin jagorancin Musa, domin na san sakamakon da zan fuskanta.
Na auri azzalumi mafi ƙarfi a lokacina, duk da haka na ƙi allolinsa na ƙarya.
Wahala ta ta yi tsanani, domin an hukunta ni saboda imanina ga Allah ɗaya tilo.
Ban taɓa yin rauni a imanina ba, ko da lokacin da na fuskanci azaba mafi tsanani.
Ubangijina ya yi farin ciki da haƙurina kuma ya zaɓe ni don zama wuri mai daraja a Aljanna.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Yin yaƙi a tafarkin Allah da runduna
Fuskantar Fir'auna da kuma bayyana bangaskiyarsa
Tafiya a kan teku tare da Musa
trial.answer: Fuskantar Fir'auna da kuma bayyana bangaskiyarsa

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: Ya zama annabi bayan shekaru da yawa
Ya fitar da Isra'ilawa daga Masar
An ba shi ikon mallakar Masar
An yi shahada kuma Allah ya girmama shi
Rayuwa har tsufa cikin jin daɗi
outcome.answer: An yi shahada kuma Allah ya girmama shi

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
